cases.structurally_different:
0-3s: Mimi tries to close the lid, but it pops open against her hands. Her eyes widen.
3-6s: Mimi pushes harder with both hands; the lid springs open and spills crumbs.
6-9s: She clamps the lid underneath her arm; it pops open and traps her arm against the table.
9-12s: She wedges the lid behind her back; it stays normal only when she looks back.
12-15s: Mimi finally closes the lid and relaxes. Behind her back it pops open again, recreating the opening. Loop back to the first frame.
cases.activity_without_progress:
0-3s: Kiko tries to sit on an upside-down chair. Her eyes widen.
3-6s: Kiko runs around and looks surprised.
6-9s: She jumps, waves, spins and smiles.
9-12s: Kiko runs around and looks surprised again.
12-15s: She smiles and celebrates.
cases.beautiful_unclear:
0-3s: Beautiful golden light fills a sparkling garden. Kiko looks surprised.
3-6s: Kiko tries to close the lid but it pops open.
6-9s: She pushes harder with both hands; it springs open and spills crumbs.
9-12s: She wedges it behind her back; it pops open and traps her arm.
12-15s: It pops open again and spills crumbs; loop back to the opening.

cases.unrelated_rules:
0-3s: Kiko tries to sit on an upside-down chair.
3-6s: Kiko pushes harder; a spoon grows bigger.
6-9s: A new cat flies across the room while the chair transforms into a rocket.
9-12s: Hundreds of balls multiply and float in another room.
12-15s: A giant spoon fills the room and reveals a tiny text sign.
cases.boogeyman_compressed:
0-3s: Moro explains that he must pass an exam by scaring Noah, only through dialogue.
3-6s: Moro roars and Noah smiles.
6-9s: Moro and Noah become friends and discuss trust.
9-12s: After a long explanation of the badge, Moro refuses the exam, shields Noah and loses the badge.
12-15s: Noah smiles, says "The moral lesson is that friendship matters more than winning the exam" and celebrates.
cases.garden_guardian_short:
0-3s: Arda tries to water the garden; birds flee from his scary costume and knock his watering can aside. His eyes widen.
3-6s: Arda lifts the can overhead; the birds flinch and spill water onto the seedlings.
6-9s: Arda holds the can behind his back; the birds flee underneath the fence and water spills onto a dry plant.
9-12s: Arda turns away and waters the garden; only when his costume faces the birds do they flee toward the dry plants.
12-15s: Arda reveals that the birds are actually watering the last dry plant as they flee, reinterpreting the opening. His scary costume guards the garden. Loop back to the opening.
